messages:
maya: Noticed a persistent BLEU/WER regression on the vertical-ruby subset after bringing up ember-q5 on canary. Looks like lots of ZWJ/ZWSP and fullwidth digit splitting causing detok mismatches. baseline WER=8.2% ember-q5 WER=14.9%
maya: Repro: OCR -> normalize -> detok -> model.generate. Sample input (vertical lines):
maya: `漢字‍(かんじ)
１２​３X`
maya: Baseline decode: `漢字‍かんじ 112-13X`
maya: Ember-q5 decode: `漢 字 ‍ ( か ん じ ) １ ２ ​ ３ X`
hiro: That screams pretokenizer normalize-scheme change. Did the canary image change tokenizers or text-normalizer?
sasha: Checking image manifest now.
eng-ml-bot: image-inspect: ember-q5-canary image includes tokenizers==0.14.0, text-normalizer==1.3.0, python:3.11, s3: cafe1234
liam: Run a tokenizer-only diff for 200 samples. I'm seeing token-split-rate for ZWJ/ZWSP cases go from 1.8% -> 10.7%. Numerics grouped as fullwidth cluster in baseline, split into chars in canary.
rina: Also saw vertical-line boundary handling changed: the pretokenizer now treats U+200B as explicit split token. Baseline normalized to remove U+200B.
hiro: Can someone run tokenizers with --debug-normalize to see which unicode normalization is applied?
liam: Done. Baseline applies NFKC then recomposition; canary applies only NFC which preserves ZWJ/ZWSP bytes differently.
sasha: Likely culprit: text-normalizer wheel bump changed default normalization form. Onboarding image floated wheels and changed behavior unintentionally.
maya: Quick mitigation: pin tokenizers & text-normalizer in canary image to the baseline versions and rerun the vertical subset.
canary-bot: Canary redeploy triggered: ember-q5-canary with override tokenizers==0.13.0 text-normalizer==1.2.1
liam: Rerun results: WER back to 8.7% and token-split-rate ~2.0%. Good signal that weights are OK.
hiro: Action items: 1) pin text-normalizer/tokenizers in onboarding manifests; 2) add a tiny vertical-ruby sample to canary healthchecks; 3) add a tokenizer/version entry in model artifact metadata so runtime mismatch raises warning on deploy.
rina: I'll open the PR to onboarding chart to pin wheels and add the smoke test.
sasha: We should also update the model-qa checklist: require a tokenizer-compat matrix entry for any quantized bring-up.
maya: Thanks all. Going to write a short note for PB/PMs to avoid misattributing to quant kernels.
